Job description

Job Description Sales Executive (Industrial Spray Paints)

Company: Ivysol Corporation
Position: Sales Executive
Job Location: Pune,Himachal Pradesh,Punjab,Chennai
Head Office: Noida
Industry: Industrial Spray Paints & Surface Coating Solutions
Experience: 05 Years

About the Role

Ivysol Corporation is looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Sales Executive to strengthen our presence across Himachal Pradesh. The ideal candidate should possess strong communication skills, a passion for sales, and the ability to build long-term customer relationships.

Freshers with excellent communication skills, strong business acumen, and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate new business opportunities and develop potential customers.
  • Visit industrial customers, OEMs, fabricators, powder coating units, and manufacturing facilities.
  • Present and promote Ivysol's range of spray paint and coating solutions.
  • Conduct product demonstrations and coordinate product trials at customer sites.
  • Maintain regular follow-ups with prospects and existing customers.
  • Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.
  • Prepare sales reports, market feedback, and competitor analysis.
  • Coordinate with internal teams for order processing and customer support.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
  • 05 years of sales experience in industrial products, paints, coatings, chemicals, hardware, lubricants, or related industries.
  • Freshers with exceptional communication skills and a strong willingness to learn will also be considered.
  • Strong negotiation and relationship-building abilities.
  • Must own a bike/two-wheeler and possess a valid driving license.
  • Basic knowledge of MS Office and reporting tools.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary will be offered based on knowledge, skills, and experience.
  • Attractive performance-based incentives.
  • Professional training and growth opportunities.
  • Opportunity to work with a growing industrial spray paint manufacturer.

Interview Process

  • Selected candidates will be required to visit our Head Office in Noida for the final interview or trainning session.
